name: PRESSED: The Final Deadline
source:
A young bear hopes to finally escape the mountainous shadow of fear cast by his small town Appalachian community over him, but has one final hurdle to clear before he can make his move for freedom. But what starts as just a monotonous part of his job soon leads to the discovery of a decades-old mystery that persists just below the surface of the town, currently dormant and hidden away. Unbeknownst to its citizens, an unforeseen event may be the catalyst to trigger disaster. Can the truth be pieced together in time? 

[From Itch.io]
